decision: The extended M09 mesh is not rejected solely for differing from the approximate H/20 recommendation. It is a reasonable initial short W01 pilot candidate after boundary and startup checks, but wave-grid accuracy is unvalidated.

installed_primary_guideline.streamwise_spacing: lambda/80 to lambda/100; for lambda20, 0.25 to 0.20 m
installed_primary_guideline.vertical_spacing: About H/20; for H0.5, about0.025 m
installed_primary_guideline.interpretation: Mesh-design guidance, not a universal pass/fail limit or demonstration of accuracy.
installed_primary_guideline.transitions: Avoid changes of vertical resolution within the wave zone.
installed_primary_guideline.timestep: P/(2.4*n) is an initial guideline for first/fifth-order waves; actual propagation, interface motion and time-step sensitivity still require checking.
installed_primary_guideline.bottom: The installed guideline specifies inlet, no-slip or slip-wall bottom boundaries and explicitly excludes symmetry at the bottom.

measurement_limits: Ray counts include partially intersected end cells and small grazing intersections; they are not equivalent to that many full uniform cells.
Polygon bounding-box extents are not effective face-normal spacings. Tiny ray chords near vertices must not be used as physical cell size or CFL limits.
Topology and mesh quality passed independently; neither that result nor these counts establishes wave propagation accuracy.
The 1 ms no-foil R5 result does not transfer automatically to the much smaller streamwise free-surface cells of the foil mesh.
economical_controlled_check: Use the preserved current mesh for a bounded pilot only. Compare incoming-wave gauges outside forcing and sufficiently upstream of the foil; compare whole-cycle height, phase, mean level and equal-phase inventory. Downstream disturbances from the foil are physical and must not be judged against a no-foil analytic wave without separating them.

Create one coherent free-surface refinement variant while preserving the foil geometry, near-wall spacing, prism layers, near-foil controls and domain. Existing raw M09 FS target is about0.0285714 m; target0.020 m is a practical first refinement. Confirm resulting geometry rather than treating input size as achieved spacing.

Extend the refined wave band across the complete domain and generated extension strips, including forcing/damping zones; avoid improving only the foil-local surface or leaving coarse extension bands. Cover the predicted complete crest/trough envelope with at least10% margin; place vertical growth transitions outside this envelope.

If supported by the mesh builder, refine vertical spacing independently while retaining sufficient streamwise spacing. Otherwise document that the0.020 target also changes horizontal resolution and treat it as coupled free-surface refinement, not a vertical-only test.

Run the same established boundary treatment, wave, domain, timestep and inner settings on the pair. Use a timestep shown adequate on the refined wave mesh, then compare wave-gauge amplitude/phase/mean and complete-cycle mean and harmonic force responses. Retain separate pressure/viscous Fx comparisons.
Each changed foil wave mesh needs its own matched calm reference. Do not use the current C01 mesh's calm result as the matched reference for a regenerated grid.
Escalate to further refinement only if the controlled pair shows consequential changes; do not rebuild or discard the validated foil boundary-layer mesh simply to hit a nominal count.

temporal_note.warning: This approximate~0.56ms guideline is not a measured stability limit; actual field/interface CFL and temporal sensitivity govern admission.
